column2: the planned code-review regression fixtures seed `collector-results.env` under `round-1/` instead of at the path the pipeline actually writes (`review_tmpdir` root, parent of `round-1`). that exercises only the first path-order slot, so the test can pass while `_collector_env_paths_for_round` never consults the parent collector and the real `/review --diff` vendor-fallback path stays unverified.
